description:
Is ICICI Lombard still the undisputed king of general insurance in India? In this masterclass, we decode the Q4 FY26 results, exploring why this large-cap leader crossed the historic ₹28,000 crore Gross Direct Premium Income mark.

Key Insights Covered:

Strategic Accumulation: Why 19.1% ROAE matters.

The "Under-Penetrated" Opportunity: India’s $750B financial market by 2026.

Combined Ratio Deep Dive: Comparing ICICI Lombard (111.2%) vs. New India Assurance.

Digital Transformation: How 98% digital policy issuance is cutting costs.

2035 Outlook: Can the profit reach ₹8,000 Crores?
